How long is each primary protein, and how are its coding exons and exon boundaries distributed along its own sequence?
Amino-acid position on each species' own primary protein
Native coordinates are not homologous alignment coordinates: the same x position in two lanes is not the same residue. Use the MSA-aligned exon architecture for positional comparison.
